final: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), cross_pattern AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS avg_igg FROM pattern_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, p.avg_igg - c.avg_igg AS above_cross_pattern_avg FROM pattern_averages p CROSS JOIN cross_pattern c WHERE p.avg_igg > c.avg_igg) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, above_cross_pattern_avg, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM above_average) AS difference_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average ORDER BY avg_igg DESC
